mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.questions (id, content, type, quiz_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{content}, #{type, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{quizId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.questions SET content = #{content}, type = #{type, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, quiz_id = #{quizId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, content, type, quiz_id, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.questions WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY created_at

SELECT id, source_type, source_text, generation_brief, alt_text, status, image_name, storage_key, url, media_type, content_hash, byte_size, error_code, error_message FROM edu.question_images WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.question_images (id, question_id, source_type, source_text, generation_brief, alt_text, status, image_name, storage_key, url, media_type, content_hash, byte_size, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{image.id}, gen_random_uuid()), #{questionId}, COALESCE(#{image.sourceType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$Image$SourceType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, 'UPLOAD'), #{image.sourceText}, #{image.generationBrief}, #{image.altText}, COALESCE(#{image.status, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$Image$Status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, 'READY'), #{image.imageName}, #{image.storageKey}, #{image.url}, #{image.mediaType}, #{image.contentHash}, #{image.byteSize}, #{image.errorCode}, #{image.errorMessage}, NOW(), NOW())
